description: Mission-only features. They feed the browser Mission Fit and NEVER the Analog Score (see targets.json scoring.forbidden_features).

trafficable_frac.definition: fraction of land DEM pixels (ETOPO 2022, 60 arc-second) with slope < slope_threshold_deg inside each 0.25 deg cell
trafficable_frac.caveat: 60 arc-second pixels (~1.85 km) smooth out local slopes, so this overestimates trafficability at rover scale

slope_p90_deg.definition: 90th-percentile slope of land DEM pixels inside each 0.25 deg cell

ice_proxy.definition: product of two desirability components: cold (annual mean daytime LST below 0 degC) x patchy snow/ice (low but non-zero IGBP snow-and-ice percentage)
ice_proxy.is: a coarse indicator of cold ground with some but not total perennial snow/ice cover, i.e. where ground ice is plausible
ice_proxy.is_not: a measurement of subsurface ice, ice depth or ice content; no global dataset used here observes subsurface ice
